notes: Owner authorized review and preparation planning. Source rights, per-item licenses, privacy, provenance, consent, exact downloaded release and hashes remain separate fail-closed requirements.

blockers: Third-party website/forum/news/Wikipedia content requires source-level rights and attribution policy
Pin exact revision and compute source/prepared hashes

public_metadata_review.finding: Public dataset card currently reports CC-BY-4.0, 9,075,453 rows and 22.8 GB; records include source URLs and corpus aggregates third-party websites, forums, news and Wikipedia.
public_metadata_review.next_gate: No ingestion until source-level rights, attribution, privacy, exact revision and file hashes are verified.

blockers: Acquire only through the official Mozilla Data Collective catalogue; do not use the legacy Hugging Face mirror as the source of the v27 release
Pin the exact Turkish v27 release, record downloaded file inventory and SHA-256 values
Verify release-specific speaker contribution, consent/provenance and privacy metadata before preparation
Confirm sufficient persistent storage for the listed 2.79 GB release plus extracted/prepared data
Keep training_allowed=false until the exact prepared dataset and human review are approved

public_metadata_review.finding: Official Mozilla Data Collective catalogue lists Common Voice Scripted Speech 27.0 Turkish (tr), ASR, CC0-1.0, MP3, 2.79 GB. Direct Hugging Face inspection found the legacy mozilla-foundation/common_voice_17_0 dataset empty with a notice that Common Voice datasets moved exclusively to Mozilla Data Collective effective October 2025; the candidate v27 HF repo ID was not found. Therefore the official MCD catalogue is the current discovery/download source; this does not establish speaker-level provenance/consent or authorize training.
public_metadata_review.next_gate: Use the official Mozilla Data Collective release only. Before any download/preparation, verify dataset-specific contributor/consent metadata, exact release contents, storage capacity and checksums; training remains blocked until a prepared dataset manifest receives explicit review.

blockers: Exclude non-commercial assets for commercial-intent training

public_metadata_review.finding: Dataset card states collection ODC-By 1.0 and per-object licenses include CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-NC-4.0, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0 and CC0 1.0.
public_metadata_review.next_gate: Read each asset's license and metadata; exclude incompatible/non-commercial assets for commercial-intent use; preserve attribution and review share-alike obligations.

public_metadata_review.finding: Official COCO terms license annotations and website CC-BY-4.0 but explicitly state COCO does not own image copyrights and images remain subject to Flickr terms.
public_metadata_review.next_gate: Image training remains blocked without item-level image rights evidence; annotation license does not clear image pixels.

blockers: Obtain authorized access and verify each source repository/file license
Preserve provenance and remove disallowed files

public_metadata_review.finding: BigCode documentation says each code item remains subject to its original repository license and attribution. Current Hugging Face dataset page is gated and requires agreement to terms and sharing contact information with maintainers.
public_metadata_review.next_gate: Do not request gated access or share contact information. Use only an authorized release with source-level licenses, provenance, current opt-out exclusions and pinned hashes.

owner_approval.scope: public-source review, evidence recording, non-destructive validation and preparation planning
owner_approval.note: Project-owner authorization to proceed with review is recorded. It does not grant third-party rights or satisfy per-source, per-item, privacy, consent, provenance, or license checks.
